id.description: Unique id; messages name it in from / to.

sublabel.description: A second, muted line under the title (a route, a product name).

icon.description: An icon tag from the IconSpec registry (brands.sonos, lucide.database); drawn on the card. Must resolve — check with GET /api/v1/icons or the pack's icon_pack.json.

ref.description: Another chart (by name, any format — e.g. this system's C4 chart); drawn as Open ↗ under the card.
